text_block_list.text:
Challenging the Takarazuka Kinen with a
new
perspective, Матиканэфукукитару
makes a
miraculous comeback.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Eager to sweep through the rest of
summer, she
has a completely new
outlook on running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Regardless, she decides to let fortune
slips
choose her next race, as usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But this time she won't be relying on
luck—she
wants to prove that she can
take on whatever
challenge fate has in
store.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time to take on the Hakodate Kinen!

Matikanefukukitaru hurtles toward the
land of the
million-dollar night view!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time to take on the Kokura Kinen!

Matikanefukukitaru hurtles toward a
blazing
battle in Kyushu, the land of the
fire gods!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time to take on the Sapporo Kinen!

Matikanefukukitaru aims for victory in
the
midsummer heat, determined to
create a festival
of luck to rival the
winter Snow Festival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
